queries.query: Fukushima City official cadastral map parcel GIS public map API Japan Fukushima city cadastral map
queries.result: Official Fukushima City results identified the city’s public e-map and its 地番参考図 (parcel-number reference map) theme. A previously indexed ArcGIS FeatureServer was also found, but the current anonymous endpoint returned HTTP 400 Invalid URL; no parcel geometry was obtained.

queries.query: 福島市 地籍図 GIS 公開 地図 不動産 登記 地図
queries.result: Official Japanese results identify Fukushima City’s 地番参考図 as a public reference map in ふくしまeマップ and identify Fukushima Legal Affairs Bureau as the local real-estate-registration office. The e-map configuration exposes a 地番参考図 raster theme, not a public parcel-vector response.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Fukushima City Asset Tax Division (資産税課) publishes the city’s 地番参考図 through ふくしまeマップ; Fukushima Legal Affairs Bureau is the local real-estate-registration office.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: Fukushima City’s official page says the 地番参考図 provides land parcel numbers and approximate shapes for Fukushima City and is available through the public e-map. The city warns it is reference information, not proof for rights, obligations, surveying, or transactions.
